import MumfordLib.SingularAffineEvaluation
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionNaturality

/-!
# Degreewise singular barycentric subdivision producer

The ordered affine subdivision operator can be evaluated along an arbitrary
singular simplex. This file packages that construction degreewise. The chain
commutativity and chain homotopy equations are separate downstream producers;
the definition here deliberately does not claim them.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {n : ℕ}

/-- Degreewise barycentric subdivision of integral singular chains. -/
def singularSubdivision (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n ⟶ (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n :=
  Sigma.desc fun σ => vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫
    barycentricSubdivision n n ≫
      (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ)).f n

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSimplexChain_subdivision
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    singularSimplexChain σ ≫ singularSubdivision X n =
      vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫ barycentricSubdivision n n ≫
        (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ)).f n :=
  Sigma.ι_desc _ _

/-- Subdivision on a face is the affine subdivision of that face, evaluated
along the original simplex. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_face_subdivision
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    singularSimplexChain ((TopCat.toSSet.obj X).δ i σ) ≫ singularSubdivision X n =
      vertexListChain (stdSimplex.vertex ∘ i.succAbove) ≫
        barycentricSubdivision (n + 1) n ≫
          (affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n + 1⦌) σ)).f n := by
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivision, affineSingularEvaluation_face]
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision n n), barycentricSubdivision_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc, vertexListChain_vertices_map_assoc]

@[simp]
theorem singularSubdivision_zero (X : TopCat) : singularSubdivision X 0 = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivision]
  change vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ _ = _
  simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id,
    vertexListChain_vertices_affineSingularEvaluation, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- Subdivision commutes with every continuous map of topological spaces. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivision_naturality {Y : TopCat} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    singularSubdivision X n ≫
        (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n =
      (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n ≫
        singularSubdivision Y n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  change singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _ = singularSimplexChain σ ≫ _
  rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivision_assoc]
  erw [singularSimplexChain_map_assoc f σ, singularSimplexChain_subdivision]
  erw [← HomologicalComplex.comp_f (affineSingularEvaluation _) _,
    affineSingularEvaluation_postcomp]
  rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
